meta.title: TimeCop: The Missing Grail
meta.blurb: A career time criminal has slipped into the past. History is missing something sacred.

S01.text:
The briefing is short.

Temporal theft. High value.

A Mastermind has breached the timeline and vanished somewhere in the medieval era. Artifacts are going missing—objects that should still exist.

One file flashes on the screen longer than the others:

THE HOLY GRAIL — STATUS: UNKNOWN

If the Grail is gone, history isn’t just altered. It’s bleeding.

Your jump window is narrow.

S02.text:
The jump hits hard.

Stone replaces steel. Smoke replaces neon.

You arrive outside a fortified monastery. The air hums with temporal residue—fresh. Someone was here recently.

If the Grail was taken, this is where history first broke.

S03.text:
The Mastermind isn’t a killer.

They’re worse.

A professional looter of history. They don’t change wars—they steal treasures before anyone notices they mattered.

Every theft makes their future richer and everyone else’s poorer.

They never stay long.

S04.text:
Inside the monastery, panic has already set in.

Monks whisper of a stranger who spoke strangely and vanished into light.

The Grail chamber is empty.

History has been robbed.

choices.label: SECURE THE TIMELINE AND SEAL THE ERA

S05.text:
Your scanner lights up.

A temporal jump signature—sloppy, rushed.

The Mastermind didn’t escape cleanly. They’re wounded or desperate.

You could follow them… or close the breach now.

S06.text:
You catch them between moments.

The Mastermind holds the Grail, awe and greed fighting on their face.

"You have no idea what this is worth," they say.

They offer you a deal.

One artifact. One future changed—for you.

choices.label: LET THEM ESCAPE WITH THE GRAIL
TAKE THE GRAIL FOR YOUR AGENCY

GOOD_END.text:
The Grail is returned.

The Mastermind is erased from the timeline.

History stabilizes.

No one will ever know how close it came to unraveling.

That’s the job.

BAD_END.text:
The timeline holds—but barely.

The Grail is gone.

Some futures are richer. Others poorer.

Your report will never be read aloud.

SPECIAL_END.text:
The Grail vanishes into secure containment.

History remains intact—but altered.

Somewhere, someone notices a future that shouldn’t exist.

You feel like you’ve just become a target.
